fact: Awarri, a Lagos startup working with the Nigerian government, has released N-ATLAS models in Yoruba, Igbo, Hausa, accented Nigerian English and Pidgin, trained on voice data collected through LangEasy with 3MTT contributors, while it relies on Amazon and Google cloud because Nigeria lacks data centres for large-scale AI training (TechCabal, 26 September 2025).
title: Nigeria wants an AI that speaks like its people, but can it deliver?
